Partner with NYUSFF

The NYU Sports Film Festival (NYUSFF) is the largest sports film festival in North America, celebrating the intersection of sports and film. Co-produced by the NYU Production Lab, NYU Athletics, and the NYU Tisch Institute for Global Sport, the festival showcases world-class storytelling while connecting creators, industry leaders, and brands.

Why Partner with Us

Join North America's largest sports film festival and connect with a dynamic audience of creators, athletes, and media professionals. All sponsor donations are tax deductible.

Unmatched Reach

Connect with 53,000+ students and 700,000+ alumni across New York City and NYU's 13 global sites.

Gen Z Influence

Engage with the 18–28-year-old audience driving cultural trends for Gen Z and beyond.

Global Platform

In 2026, the festival received 152 film submissions from 25 states and 23 countries, and continues to grow internationally.

Prestige & Network

Align with NYU's world-class brand—Tisch ranked #1 film school in the U.S. (TheWrap, 2024).

Media Exposure

Annual hour-long TV special broadcast on SNY with commercial slots, press coverage, and digital campaigns.

Tax Deductible

All sponsor donations are tax deductible, maximizing your investment value.

Festival Highlights

Experience the excitement and prestige of NYUSFF through our signature events and programming:

Screenings

16 films screened across three nights in 2026, including feature-length films for the first time, at NYU's Cantor Film Center.

Panels & Q&As

With award-winning professionals from Gersh, the NBPA, MLB, NBC, FOX Sports, ESPN, and CBS Sports.

Pitch Contest

Shark Tank–style competition, presented with PlayersTV, giving creators direct access to decision-makers. In 2026, $5,000 went toward producing a winning pitch.

Athletics Film Workshops

Two 2026 sessions with NYU Athletics paired student filmmakers with athletes from swimming, track, judo, baseball, basketball, kendo, and squash.

Networking Opportunities

2026 brands included MSG Sports, CBS Sports, Gersh, NBPA, NFL Films, WME, ESPN, Amazon, HBO Sports, and more.

Star Guests

2026 brought out Walt "Clyde" Frazier, Bill Bradley, William "Worldwide Wes" Wesley, and producer Mike Tollin. Past honorees include Ted Lasso's Bill Lawrence.
